title: 1st Game Jam (Bar Brawler)
author: Brewgazer
selftext:
So i submitted this for my first game jam. It is my fourth game using Ai.  
I have cursor pro and utilized opus 5, grok 4.5 and composer 2.5.  
I had my cursor connected to blender giving it skills from a GitHub that I had found.   
I’ve seen these models create but never like how it had with this game having it connected and with the skills.   
I used 36% usage of opus 5 and 17% usage of grok and composer(cursors models which cost less than opus allowing for more usage)   
This took about 8-12 prompts. 1st prompt was a master prompt and was created with opus and knocked out the majority of the game loop and graphics. After that I used cursor on auto to tweak the rest and build onto the bar as well as add mini games to play while drinking.   
Would love feedback on this as I do plan on building an open world town around the bar and giving the player more things to do. Thanks in advance! 

https://brewgazer.itch.io/last-call

comments.author: ZymzAlchemy
comments.body:
I dig the vibe, but the text is tiny and I'm old lol. But it looks like a fun casual pickup. I've always been a fan of the bit-block 3D thing. 

Be well, keep creating.

replies.author: Brewgazer
replies.body: Thanks! I hope you enjoy/enjoyed trying it out if you do/did!

replies.author: ZymzAlchemy
